items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Joe Harris. Sammy Penn. Sammy Penn. He was in the band.

ctx.x: Good trombone player. No. Good trombone player. Raymond Brown. Raymond Brown.

Raymond Brown is a good trombone player. I played with his band. We had a band by the name of. Footwomber. Mmhmm. Footwomber. Footwomber. When was this? That. That's been about. Mag Darcy. Mag Darcy band. Mag Darcy band. Mag Darcy band. Mag Darcy band. Tom Harris played in the band. Joe Harris. Oh I know Tom Harris. A bass player? Yeah. Well I do. Well he played the band. I know him for. He died. I knew him during the war. I knew him during the war. He was a shortfall. He was a shortfall. Yeah. And spin the bass…
He played with Daniel. Daniel. He died too. You do. Who else was in that band?
